items.title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings

motions.item_title: Enactment Of By-laws – First, Second & Third Readings
motions.text: That the following by-laws be approved.

That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $7,990,000 ($3,252,724 principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $4,737,276 principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for a Capital Work of The Corporation of the City of Cambridge, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-048, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $7,990,000 ($3,252,724 principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $4,737,276 principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for a Capital Work of The Corporation of the City of Cambridge, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-048, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $49,709,000 ($1,169,000 principal amount of five year instalment debentures, $20,131,164 principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $28,408,836 principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Kitchener, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-049, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $49,709,000 ($1,169,000 principal amount of five year instalment debentures, $20,131,164 principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $28,408,836 principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for Capital Works of The Corporation of the City of Kitchener, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-049, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon ten year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $8,750,000 for a Capital Work of The Corporation of the City of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-050, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon ten year instalment debentures in the principal amount of $8,750,000 for a Capital Work of The Corporation of the City of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-050, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $30,551,000 ($18,933,112 aggregate principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $11,617,888 aggregate principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for capital works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo , be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-051, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to authorize the borrowing upon debentures in the aggregate principal amount of $30,551,000 ($18,933,112 aggregate principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $11,617,888 aggregate principal amount of twenty year term debentures) for capital works of The Regional Municipality of Waterloo, be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-051, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That a By-law to provide for the borrowing of the aggregate of the principal amounts authorized by By-laws numbered 25-048, 25-049, 25-050 and 25-051 and for the issuing of one series of debentures therefor in the aggregate principal amount of $97,000,000 ($1,169,000 principal amount of five year instalment debentures, $51,067,000 aggregate principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $44,764,000 aggregate principal amount of twenty year term debentures), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-052, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.
motions.text_html: That a By-law to provide for the borrowing of the aggregate of the principal amounts authorized by By-laws numbered 25-048, 25-049, 25-050 and 25-051 and for the issuing of one series of debentures therefor in the aggregate principal amount of $97,000,000 ($1,169,000 principal amount of five year instalment debentures, $51,067,000 aggregate principal amount of ten year instalment debentures and $44,764,000 aggregate principal amount of twenty year term debentures), be read a first, second and third time, finally passed and numbered 25-052, be signed by the Regional Chair and Regional Clerk and sealed with the Regional Seal.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 10:51 a.m.
